title: VIP Intake: Signal-to-Sprint Conversion Playbook and Dynamic Windowing
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: We receive ad-hoc feature asks and escalations from top accounts that lack a consistent conversion path into prioritized roadmap work. That creates unpredictable engineering load, stakeholder frustration, and mismatched expectations about delivery windows.

Goal: Create a repeatable playbook that converts account signals (escalations, product feedback, revenue risk) into objectively scored intake items with a bounded escalation budget, dynamic scheduling windows, and clear follow-up cadence. The playbook should be operational (runbook + decision matrix + automated scoring), integratable with Linear and our customer intake forms, and enable rapid canary/partial-scope deliveries for urgent customers without destabilizing the roadmap.

Scope:
- Define intake signals and normalized weights (revenue, renewal risk, product fit, legal/compliance urgency).
- Create an "escalation budget" construct per account (credits per quarter) and a gating policy for above-budget requests.
- Build dynamic windowing rules that map priority buckets to committed sprint windows (immediate, next-cycle, deferred) and automated notifications to account owners.
- Draft templates for PM <> AE <> Solutions handoffs and SLAs for communication.
- Instrument dashboards (Console usage, run-rate, backlog churn) to measure policy impact.

Out of scope for this ticket: implementation of RBAC controls for Private customers and dedicated autoslot auctioning mechanics (will be separate tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Published playbook doc in Confluence with decision matrix and worked examples
Intake form updated to emit structured signals and weights
Escalation budget model defined and approved by Revenue Ops
Automation spec for Linear tagging and notification flows reviewed by ENG
Dashboard prototype showing top-account backlog by priority and budget consumption
